
cdrom/cd-init-args
A Nop right after an Init refused for its four parameters (nugget cdlInitWithArgs), and where the slow
maintenance cycles fall after an Init. Cycles from each write to its interrupt; histogram in 16,384-cycle
steps (the last 180,224+). No assertions.
